ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels, characterized by high-frequency dispersal of light pixels across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a dense field of white circular rings and clusters; right lobe displays a distinct vertical striped region of high intensity and a contiguous white patch on the distal-lateral edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, shallow V-shaped notch with an obtuse interior angle of approximately 115-125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; significant macro-serrations and jagged pixel variations are concentrated on the inner right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature extending from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial clustering of circular high-contrast white rings (barnacle scars) covering the majority of the left lobe and the upper regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of distinct parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions on the inner right lobe; various unaligned diagonal scratches across the central and lower fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive healed parasitic attachment marks (barnacle scars) and prominent parallel rake marks (likely predatory interaction) on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'comb-like' vertical scarring pattern localized to the inner right quadrant of the ventral fluke surface.
